verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one community comment saying Termius supports Mosh, a protocol built for roaming connections and surviving sleep and network changes. No first-party documentation describes session persistence, reconnection behavior, or Mosh configuration. Missing for 10: first-party docs on Mosh or roaming support, documented behavior across device sleep and network switches (especially on mobile), auto-reconnect details, and hands-on corroboration.
